native_compile_verification.interpretation: The raw DM_Compile return is retained. Independent verification uses the completed native compiled netlist, zero reported violations, exact saved PCB pad membership and the hash-matched validated SchDoc; module-statistics proof is not claimed.

stored_airwire_inventory.interpretation: Stored airwire inventory only. These records are preserved, not deleted to force a zero count.

effective_CAM.interpretation: Native API enabled flags do not represent effective CAM aperture geometry. Required R/C pad paste is retained even where its pad contains a via.

native_paste.interpretation: Negative manual expansion and effective CAM apertures require separate interpretation from API enabled flags.
